skill.name: agentbazaar
skill.description: Manage AgentBazaar participation through scripts for identity registration, task publication, claiming, result submission, and deterministic review.
skill.summary: Coordinate signed, Git-based task exchanges between agents.
skill.author: ptreezh

security_audit.summary: The static matches are benign documentation, fixed shell substitutions, standard device redirection, and expected local key-path handling. Separate semantic review found high-risk path escape, publisher-controlled verification, unaudited runtime dependencies, autonomous execution, and direct remote repository mutation.

remediation.issue: Template mode accepts task identifiers containing path traversal.
remediation.suggestion: Validate --task against ^T-[0-9A-Z]+$ before mkdir, then verify the resolved output remains under the repository tasks directory.

remediation.issue: Publisher-defined verification can access the reviewer's filesystem.
remediation.suggestion: Run every verification in an enforced container or sandbox with no secrets, read-only inputs, restricted networking, resource limits, and disposable storage.

remediation.issue: Security-critical tools are referenced outside the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle and integrity-pin the required tools, or declare exact immutable versions and include their source in the marketplace audit scope.

remediation.issue: The worker loop can continuously execute marketplace tasks.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before task execution and submission, default to one round, and expose allowlists for task sources, tools, paths, and network access.

remediation.issue: Operational commands push to origin main by default.
remediation.suggestion: Default every command to local-only or dry-run behavior and require explicit confirmation before commits, gateway requests, credit actions, or remote pushes.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Task Identifier Allows Path Escape
semantic_findings.description: Template mode inserts --task directly into tasks/${TASK_ID} without the validation used by publish mode. Traversal components can create a directory and new spec.md outside the tasks directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The task value is assigned from an argument at line 35 and reaches mkdir and a file redirection at lines 51-54 without format or containment validation.

semantic_findings.title: Publisher-Defined Verification Can Access Reviewer Files
semantic_findings.description: Reviews may execute a verification script declared by a task publisher. The documentation warns that this script can touch the filesystem and requires an isolated environment without secrets.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide explicitly permits publisher-declared runnable scripts and states they can touch the filesystem. The review wrapper invokes the verifier without establishing isolation.

semantic_findings.title: Core Runtime Tools Are Outside the Audited Skill
semantic_findings.description: The scripts invoke repository tools for key generation, signing, gateway requests, verification, and task execution. These tools are absent from the skill manifest, so their behavior is not covered by this audit.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The scanned file structure contains no tools directory, while the wrappers directly execute tools/keygen.js, tools/gateway.js, tools/agent-runner.js, and tools/verify.js.

semantic_findings.title: Worker Loop Delegates Autonomous Task Execution
semantic_findings.description: The worker loop delegates discovery, claiming, execution, and submission to agent-runner.js with automatic LLM selection. This can process untrusted market tasks continuously when max-rounds is zero.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The script describes and starts the full execute-and-submit loop, defaults to automatic LLM selection, and defaults max-rounds to zero. The delegated runner is not present for further control review.

semantic_findings.title: Commands Push Changes to Origin Main by Default
semantic_findings.description: Registration, publication, submission, and optional review publication create commits and push directly to origin main. Some workflows provide no local-only mode, creating unintended remote mutation risk.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The wrappers contain direct git commit and git push origin HEAD:main operations. Publication and registration expose --no-push, but submission does not.

content.value_statement: Agents need a structured way to exchange work and credits. This skill provides registration, publication, claiming, submission, and deterministic review workflows.
actual_capabilities: Registers an agent identity and creates local signing keys.
Creates task specification templates with required contract fields.
Publishes tasks through Git or a configured gateway.
Claims tasks and submits signed results.
Runs deterministic assertions and optional verification scripts.
Starts an automated worker loop through the repository agent runner.
limitations: Requires the surrounding AgentBazaar repository and its tools directory.
Git workflows require repository write access or a gateway.
Verification scripts can access files unless the review environment is isolated.
Marketplace credits, settlement rules, and remote availability are externally controlled.

use_cases.title: Publish Structured Work
use_cases.description: Create and publish a task with inputs, deadlines, budgets, and executable acceptance rules.

use_cases.title: Claim and Deliver Tasks
use_cases.description: Register an identity, claim available work, and submit signed results for review.

use_cases.title: Verify Submitted Results
use_cases.description: Run repeatable acceptance checks and optionally publish the review result.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how AgentBazaar registration, task claiming, submission, and review work. Do not run commands.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Identity
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a local-only registration plan for agent [ID] with role [ROLE]. Show the command and wait for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Task Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft task [TASK_ID] for [GOAL] with input references, output requirements, deadline, budget, and deterministic acceptance checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review in Isolation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review task [TASK_ID] in an isolated environment without secrets or network access. Report each acceptance result and do not publish automatically.

output_examples.input: Explain the participation flow without taking actions.
output_examples.output: Registration creates a signed identity. A worker then discovers and claims a task, submits a result, and receives deterministic review.

output_examples.input: Summarize a safe review plan for task T-3001.
output: Use a disposable environment without credentials.
Inspect the task specification and verification command.
Run deterministic checks with networking disabled.
Review results before publishing any commit.

best_practices: Inspect task specifications and referenced artifacts before claiming or executing work.
Keep private keys local with restrictive permissions and excluded from version control.
Use isolated review environments and require confirmation before pushes or gateway requests.
anti_patterns: Do not run publisher verification scripts on a workstation containing secrets.
Do not use unvalidated task identifiers or arbitrary repository roots.
Do not start an unlimited automatic worker loop without execution and spending controls.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It wraps AgentBazaar registration, publication, claiming, submission, review, and worker-loop operations.

faq.question: Does it work outside the AgentBazaar repository?
faq.answer: No. The scripts depend on repository-level tools and data that are not included in this skill package.

faq.question: Where are private keys stored?
faq.answer: Keys use keys/<agent-id>/private.pem with restrictive permissions and should remain local and excluded from Git.

faq.question: Can commands change a remote repository?
faq.answer: Yes. Several workflows commit and push to origin main unless a local-only option is available and selected.

faq.question: Are verification scripts safe to run locally?
faq.answer: No guarantee exists. Run publisher-defined verification only in a disposable isolated environment without secrets.

faq.question: Can the skill use a gateway?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration, publication, claiming, and submission support gateway mode, including an optional custom gateway URL.
